name: Adobe Marketo Engage
description: Adobe Marketo Engage is an enterprise marketing automation platform for B2B organizations, covering lead management, account-based marketing, email marketing, and cross-channel campaign orchestration with real-time behavioral data.
best_for: Positioned for enterprise B2B marketing and sales teams that need to manage complex, multi-decision-maker buying committees across the full lead and account lifecycle.
features: Lead management with drill-down into lead, contact, account, and opportunity details
Account-based marketing (ABM) with Target Account Management for predictive, AI-powered ideal customer profile scoring
Sales Insight for keeping marketing and sales teams synced on account activity
Real-time lead and account activity tracking, including email opens and website visits
Audience building based on roles, intent signals, and buying stage

alternatives.name: ActiveCampaign
alternatives.description: An autonomous marketing platform where AI agents handle email, SMS, WhatsApp, and CRM tasks backed by customer data.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-market businesses wanting automation without enterprise complexity

alternatives.name: Braze
alternatives.description: A customer engagement platform for personalized, cross-channel messaging with AI-driven orchestration.
alternatives.best_for: B2C brands orchestrating messaging across app, email, and SMS

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: A CRM platform with marketing, sales, and service tools built around a shared customer database.
alternatives.best_for: Growing companies wanting marketing and CRM in one connected system

pricing.starting_price: Custom pricing based on database size; contact Adobe for pricing

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Core marketing email, segmentation, automation, and measurement; pricing by request.

tiers.name: Select
tiers.notes: Marketing automation and measurement; pricing by request.

tiers.name: Prime
tiers.notes: Lead- and account-based marketing with journey analytics and AI personalization; pricing by request.

tiers.name: Ultimate
tiers.notes: Advanced marketing automation with premium attribution; pricing by request.

cons: Adobe does not publish numeric Marketo Engage prices; pricing is customized and requires contacting Adobe.
Package pricing is based on database size, so cost depends on scale rather than a simple flat self-serve subscription.
